title: Free resolution of localization on a slice
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, and let $f\in\mathcal O(U)$. On the slice site $\mathcal C/U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], write $\mathcal O_U$ for the restricted ring sheaf and $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$ for the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the presheaf $(V\to U)\mapsto\mathcal O(V)[1/f|_V]$ of sectionwise localizations. Then the sequence of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]

$$
0\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal O_U\xrightarrow{d}\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal O_U\xrightarrow{q}\mathcal O_U[1/f]\longrightarrow0
$$

is exact, where $d((x_0,x_1,\ldots))=(x_0,x_1-fx_0,x_2-fx_1,\ldots)$ and $q((x_0,x_1,\ldots))=\sum_{n\geq0}x_n/f^n$ locally (on local representatives with finite support; these formulas extend by sheafification).

telescope exact sequence presenting localization of a module at a single element
mathlib_searches.results: exact_of_isLocalized_span, IsLocalizedModule.map_exact, LocalizedModule.map_exact and ModuleCat.localizedModule_functor_map_exact preserve or test exactness under localization; none presents localization by the two countable free sums.

mathlib_searches.query: A sequential direct limit of modules has a presentation by one minus shift on the direct sum, applied to repeated multiplication by a ring element
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Module.DirectLimit, its Eqv/moduleCon/of/exists_of₂, and DirectLimit.Module.of/of_f. These construct ordinary module direct limits and do not state the sheaf localization telescope exact sequence.
Twelve hits on ordinary module direct limits, canonical maps, induction, and map identities; no localization telescope exact sequence.
25 displayed hits: Module.DirectLimit quotient construction (Algebra/Colimit/Module.lean:61), zero_exact uses, and unrelated Hom-complex shift identities; no sheaf localization telescope resolution.
